# Project Instructions

- This is a JavaScript React 19 frontend built with Vite. Keep changes consistent with the existing JSX and CSS structure; do not introduce TypeScript or additional dependencies without a clear need.
- The app entry point is `src/main.jsx`, the main screen is `src/App.jsx`, shared page styles are in `src/index.css`, and app styles are in `src/App.css`.
- Keep HTTP requests in `src/api.js`; the current task API is served at `http://localhost:8080/api/tasks`.
- Use the existing npm scripts: `npm run dev` for local development, `npm run lint` for linting, and `npm run build` to verify a production build. There is no test script configured.
- Preserve the current Oxlint rules and React Hooks conventions. Keep edits focused on the requested behavior.
